dossier.summary: Brightwave Logistics is a regional freight forwarder with about 300 people and five cross-docks in the Midwest.
dossier.why_now: Expanding the Joliet cross-dock this year.

data.notes:
Oct 13 discovery call. Leo Marsh (VP Operations) and Dana Whitfield (Director of Dispatch) for Brightwave, Maya Chen for Northbeam. Dispatch runs on spreadsheets and a TMS, and the Joliet cross-dock misses late-load alerts. Leo wants a 30-day pilot at Joliet with 12 dispatchers.
Oct 21 walkthrough with Sam Okoye (solutions engineer), using Dana's September exception log. Recording saved.
Oct 27 security pack (14 pages) sent to Priya Okafor, head of IT security. Tomas Reyes, CFO, asked for a pricing summary and signs with Leo. Decision on the pilot targeted for Nov 13. Next call Nov 4 at 10:00 CT, 50 minutes, video.
data.company: Team: Maya Chen, account executive. Sam Okoye, solutions engineer. Jordan Lee, customer success. Shared with buyers: Lakeshore Freight customer story (PDF, 6 pages), security and data handling pack (PDF, 14 pages), Joliet pilot pricing summary (PDF, 2 pages).
data.lede: One room for the operations visibility pilot at Joliet, so Leo, Dana, Priya and Tomas can find everything without digging through email.
data.note: Leo, this page holds everything from our two calls on the Joliet pilot in one place. The plan below is my draft of who does what and when, so check it and tell me what is off before Wednesday's scoping call. Priya has the security pack, and the pricing summary is the two-pager Tomas asked for.
